query: UPDATE mail_jobs SET state = 'failed', terminal_at = clock_timestamp(), failure_category = $3::text, nonce = CASE WHEN authority_kind IN ('verification', 'recovery') AND $3::text <> 'payload_unreadable' THEN nonce END, payload = CASE WHEN authority_kind IN ('verification', 'recovery') AND $3::text <> 'payload_unreadable' THEN payload END WHERE id = $1 AND state = 'in_progress' AND attempt_count = $2
